Metadata.title: Carlos Morais — Full-Stack Developer
Metadata.description: Full-Stack Developer (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL). Case studies, experience and projects.

Home.lead: Over 2 years shipping features to production on B2B/B2C SaaS platforms, with React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL and automated testing.
Home.workLead: Company code is private, so here I walk through the problem, the decisions and the outcome of each one.
Home.aboutBody: I'm based in Jacareí, Brazil, and work remotely. I started with online courses at Alura in 2022, completed about 3,000 hours of full-stack training at Alpha EdTech, and have worked in the field since 2024 — Bayer, a conversational AI startup and, today, Plumaa. I'm also currently studying Database Administration at IFRS.
Home.principle1Body: Unit and integration tests before every deploy. This site goes further: CI runs everything on every push.
Home.principle2Body: I review code and support architecture decisions as the technical reference for a small squad.
Home.principle3Body: I use Claude Code daily, with custom skills and agents for code research and test writing.
Home.contactLead: Want to talk about a project or swap ideas about code? Email or WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach me.
Home.titleMain: I build web products <k>end to end</k>

Play.note: A 2026 reimplementation of the 2024 engine: same steering and same layout, with reworked collisions (the car bounces off walls and lines up with them), gentler obstacles and the track redrawn.
